title: Learn Sass In 20 Minutes | Crash Course
description:
In this course we are going to learn sass in a very easy and fun way. 
SASS enables us to use things like variables, nested rules, inline imports and more. It also helps to keep things organised and allows us to create style sheets faster. Sass is compatible with all versions of CSS.
